name: Wire-Tech
old_description: Wire Tech has been making components for handgun and rifles since 1996. What constitutes a good firearm? We agree with most owners who say a firearm that is manufactured with quality workmanship would produce the one needed ingredient: reliability. This is something that WireTech strides to achieve with every job, customer and commitment.
about:
Wire Tech LLC operates from Watertown, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1996. The company began by producing components for handguns and rifles, establishing a focus on precision machining for firearms.

The shop specializes in wire EDM, sinker EDM, and fast-hole EDM drilling, supported by CNC milling and a full tool room. Its equipment roster includes multiple Mitsubishi wire EDMs (FX10, FA-V, FX20K, FA-10V), a Sodick ALN600G, a Mitsubishi MV1200R, an EX-8 sinker EDM, and a CNC Ct300 fast-hole driller. The facility handles prototype through production volumes, with programming performed by experienced tool and die makers using ESPRIT CAD/CAM software.

Wire Tech serves the medical, firearms, aerospace, automotive, electronics, instrumentation, and molding industries. It has supplied firearm components since 1996 and performs sub-contract work for automotive, aircraft, and small-arms manufacturers. Medical production jobs run alongside tooling and prototype work without workflow interruption.

The company emphasizes that its programming and setups are done by diemakers who understand part function and clearances, allowing computerized operations to catch deviations early. It offers 24-hour emergency service, retains all job data for exact repeat orders, and maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification with inspection capabilities including optical contour projection, hardness testing, and calibrated gauging.
